zh: 今天早上在图书馆遇到了一位很久没见的同学。
old_en: I came across an old classmate in the library this morning.
new_en: I came across a classmate I hadn't seen in a long time at the library this morning.

zh: 去年在旅行中偶然遇到了一位会说多种语言的朋友。
old_en: Last year, I came across a friend who speaks many languages while traveling.
new_en: Last year, I came across a friend who speaks many languages while traveling.

zh: 你去超市的时候，也许会遇到新朋友。
old_en: When you go to the supermarket, you might come across new friends.
new_en: You might come across new friends when you go to the supermarket.

zh: 周末去公园可能会遇到老朋友。
old_en: On weekends, you might come across old friends in the park.
new_en: You might come across old friends at the park on weekends.
